name: How often should I repaint the interior of my house?

mainEntity.name: How often should I repaint the interior of my house?

acceptedAnswer.text: The frequency of interior repainting depends on various factors, including the room's use, household activity, and personal preference. High-traffic areas like kitchens, bathrooms, and hallways may benefit from repainting every 3-5 years. Bedrooms and living rooms typically need refreshing every 5-7 years. Quality paint and proper surface preparation can extend these timelines. Ultimately, it's time to repaint when you notice fading, chipping, scuffs, or simply desire a change in aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: High-traffic areas often need repainting every 3-5 years, while other rooms can go 5-7 years, depending on wear and personal preference.
